steps.why_en: No input or rule for reduction stages exists in the repo; only unused type names remain.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada input atau aturan stage reduction di repo; hanya sisa nama tipe yang tidak dipakai.

steps.en: Officer sets how long the reduction is valid
steps.id: Officer menentukan berapa lama reduction berlaku
steps.why_en: The validity date is accepted and checked, but no officer input exists in the staff portal.
steps.why_id: Tanggal berlaku diterima dan dicek, tetapi tidak ada input officer di portal staff.

steps.en: OCMS computes the reduced amount from the stage count
steps.id: OCMS menghitung amount hasil reduction dari jumlah stage
steps.why_en: The system only checks amounts sent by the caller; it never works them out from stages.
steps.why_id: Sistem hanya mengecek jumlah yang dikirim pemanggil; tidak pernah menghitungnya dari stage.

steps.en: OCMS shows the reduced amount to the officer
steps.id: OCMS menampilkan amount hasil reduction ke officer
steps.why_en: No screen shows a computed reduced amount; the 'Reduced Amount' field is not connected to any data.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar yang menampilkan hasil hitung; kolom 'Reduced Amount' tidak terhubung ke data.

steps.en: The validity period is saved with the reduction
